annotations.title: Create, change or delete a candidate segment

description:
[Candidates] action save (create without id, update with id; name, description, kind, and rules: the same {match, rules} list_candidates takes, as an object or a JSON string), delete, or add_members / remove_members of a static segment (candidate ids). Fields left out keep their value. list_candidates takes the same rules and returns the candidates they match, without saving anything. Sends nothing to candidates. Deleting cannot be undone.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

action.description: save: create (no segment_id) or change (segment_id) a segment; delete: delete it; add_members / remove_members: change the members of a static segment.

candidate_ids.description: Candidate ids (the `id` of a list_candidates row). add_members / remove_members: the candidates to add or remove (required).

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

description.description: save: a description (at most 500 characters); null or empty clears it; kept when left out on a change.

kind.description: save: dynamic (members are the candidates matching the rules at any time) or static (a fixed list). Required when creating; cannot change.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

merchant_id.description: Optional company to act in. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's company.

name.description: save: the name (1 to 120 characters). Required when creating; kept when left out on a change.

rules.description: save: the rules of a dynamic segment, or the first members of a new static one (an object, or the same JSON as a string), checked by the database (the candidate search of list_candidates takes the same rules and shows their matches without saving).

segment_id.description: Segment id (a segment `id` from list_segments). Required for every action except creating.

name: manage_segment
